component.name: OpenGDS Auditor
component.summary: Test OPC UA certificate management against OPC 10000-12

description.p: The OpenGDS Auditor tests Global Discovery Servers, push-managed OPC UA Servers and pull clients against OPC 10000-12. Every test cites the clause it checks and gives a verdict with its evidence. Reports come as HTML, JUnit XML, TAP and JSON.

Runs are read-only unless changes to the target are allowed, and the Auditor restores the target's trust list and certificates at the end. Its results are a self-test, not OPC Foundation certification.
